notes.title: Developer Notes
notes.content:
Hi I'm SeGuVeGa the developer of Escape And Build, I want to share and finally release my game but I have some very important notes to share.

The servers will stay on from now until a month from now, then I will only start them on weekends because I don't have the budget to maintain it, and depending on the reception I will make improvements with a more powerful VM to host the games, or for keep it on every month.

I am willing to upgrade the game with any of your suggestions. 

<∞💀∞>
Enjoy the game.
